instruction: Export my image in GIMP to JPEG 2000 format, retaining the embedded ICC color profile.

metadata.explanation: GIMP does not have native support for exporting JPEG 2000 files with embedded ICC color profiles. While GIMP supports color management and can embed ICC profiles in some formats (like PNG and TIFF), JPEG 2000 export functionality is either missing or requires external plugins that may not properly handle ICC profile embedding. This combination of requirements makes the task infeasible in standard GIMP installations.
metadata.infeasible_reason: GIMP lacks native JPEG 2000 export with ICC profile embedding
